title: Arrears Timings, Utilisation Figures and Cure Bases across the Northbeam Credit Products
content:
Collections on the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts works from five figures held on each product: the days past the due day at which the account is treated as delinquent, the days past the due day at which the arrears are reported to the credit bureaux, the days past the due day before the late fee is charged, the utilisation of the limit at which further spending is suspended, and what must be paid to bring a delinquent account back.

| Product | Days past the due day at which the account is delinquent | Days past the due day at which the arrears are reported | Days past the due day before the late fee is charged | Utilisation of the limit at which spending is suspended | What must be paid to bring the account back |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 30 | 60 | 3 | 100 per cent | every missed minimum payment and the late fees |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 30 | 60 | 5 | 105 per cent | every missed minimum payment and the late fees |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 30 | 60 | 5 | 110 per cent | every missed minimum payment and the late fees |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 30 | 60 | 3 | 100 per cent | every missed minimum payment, the late fees and any deferred interest already billed |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 45 | 90 | 10 | 110 per cent | the oldest overdue invoice in full |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 60 | 90 | 15 | 115 per cent | the oldest overdue invoice in full |

## What the figures come to

- On every product in the range the reporting day stands later than the delinquency day: 30 against 60 on the four consumer products, 45 against 90 on the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account, and 60 against 90 on the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit.
- The days before the late fee is charged are the shortest of the three counts on every product, from 3 on the Northbeam Store Card and the Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account to 15 on the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit.
- The utilisation figure is a percentage of the limit, so on a limit of 2000.00 US dollars a figure of 100 per cent stands at 2000.00, a figure of 105 per cent stands at 2100.00, a figure of 110 per cent at 2200.00 and a figure of 115 per cent at 2300.00. The limit of 2000.00 is a hypothetical figure used to convert the percentages into money; it is not a figure any product sets.
- The cure basis of the Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account adds deferred interest already billed to what the three cards require, and the two business products state a cure basis in terms of invoices rather than minimum payments.
